title: Congruent figures
objective: Understand Congruent figures through the chapter source and examples.
teacher_explanation: Figures with the same shape and size that can be superimposed exactly.

title: SSS congruence
objective: Understand SSS congruence through the chapter source and examples.
teacher_explanation: Three equal corresponding side lengths guarantee triangle congruence.

title: SAS congruence
objective: Understand SAS congruence through the chapter source and examples.
teacher_explanation: Two equal sides and the included angle guarantee congruence.

title: SSA limitation
objective: Understand SSA limitation through the chapter source and examples.
teacher_explanation: Two sides and a non-included angle do not guarantee congruence.

title: AAA limitation
objective: Understand AAA limitation through the chapter source and examples.
teacher_explanation: Equal three angles determine shape but not size.

title: Correspondence order
objective: Understand Correspondence order through the chapter source and examples.
teacher_explanation: The order in ΔABC≅ΔXYZ records A↔X, B↔Y, C↔Z.
